title: Global well-posedness for 3D compressible and incompressible micropolar fluids without angular viscosity in strip domains
summary: This paper investigates an initial-boundary value problem for three-dimensional (3D) micropolar fluids in a strip domain, including both the compressible and the (homogeneous and inhomogeneous) incompressible cases in the absence of angular viscosity. The analysis is rendered difficult by two major obstacles: the degeneracy induced by vanishing angular viscosity, and the strong coupling between micro-rotation and velocity fields characterized by a non-dissipative anti-symmetric structure. Moreover, the presence of physical boundaries in the strip domain further compounds these obstacles.…
